Purpose: Monte Carlo calibration of the fixed-HAC-studentized one-sided circular-block max-T procedure
Null_Acceptance_Rule: Both tails of Binomial(400,0.05), each at 0.01/(2*4), fixed before simulation
Power_Acceptance_Rule: One-sided exact binomial lower confidence bound exceeds 0.6
Statistic: mean difference divided by original-sample Bartlett HAC standard error
Resampling: Joint centered circular blocks, exact sample length, fixed original HAC denominator
